caption: The drawing depicts a pair of elongated tongs with two oval, flat ends that resemble the shape of large spoons or paddles, rendered primarily in shades of black and gray on a beige background. The handles of the tongs are thin and straight, joined at a pivot near the oval ends, allowing the tongs to open and close. The lower oval end features engraved or stamped patterns that include lines, dots, and geometric shapes. In the upper left corner of the image, there are two circular objects displaying similar engraved patterns as on the tong's oval end, and these are labeled as being 1/6 actual size. The tongs themselves are shown at 1/3 actual size, indicated by the text on the drawing. All illustrated objects are enclosed within a thin rectangular border that frames the composition.
title: Wafer Iron
